sources.title: google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 features a context window of up to 256K tokens and maintains multilingual support in over 140 languages. Featuring both Dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, Gemma 4 is well-suited for tasks like text generation, coding, and reasoning. The models are available in five distinct sizes: E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B A4B, and 31B.

sources.snippet: Safety Gemma 4 models undergo the same rigorous infrastructure security protocols as our proprietary models. sources.title: Gemma 4 26B A4B IT API & Playground | Fireworks AI
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 26B A4B IT is a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model by Google DeepMind with 25.2B total parameters (3.8B active). It supports text and image input with a 256K context window, configurable thinking mode, native function calling, and multilingual support in 140+ languages.
